additional_artifact_findings.finding: A real NSIS installer EXE physically exists and its size, SHA-256 and embedded archive CRC were independently verified. This is packaging progress, not proof of installed native product operation.

The build-ready ZIP is a directory-wrapped exact copy of the original 76 files, with only README, shell build command and reference compiler log added. No implementation defects in the original donor were repaired.

The installer statically embeds exactly the menu/src content from the original ZIP: 75 logical source/asset paths matched by decoded SHA-256. No WPF app executable, OneHost/Python executable, native runtime DLLs, compiled modules, or model weights were found in its data payload.

Broken shortcut persists. Exact original installer.nsi sets output to $INSTDIR and File /r menu\*.*, while shortcut points to $INSTDIR\menu\index.html. Compiled header contains root index.html and menu\index.html shortcut string; compiler log records the same source.

UI timer completion and ineffective STOP; Forge false PASS; S03 mismatched readback; browser false ACK; invalid sun_glow.jpg and incomplete source pins remain byte-identical to prior reviewed package. No repeat execution needed to establish same-byte carryover.

BUILD_README explicitly says source is unmodified and Python modules have no launcher. Build script uses fixed /workspace/nox-express-wow and /workspace/nox-exec12 paths, so it is a reference command for one environment, not a portable build setup.
